aim: CueRCode is a PHP 8.4/8.5 QR-code-generator SaaS for Dreamhost shared hosting: a responsive web UI + feature-parity REST API for generating, customising, and downloading QR codes, with the web frontend built on top of the API.
definition_of_done: php -l clean on every PHP file + zero lint/standards/security warnings before each commit
core QR generation works end-to-end via Web UI AND REST API (feature parity)
automated coverage exists for core flows (payload builders, generate pipeline, API auth/rate-limit, response formatting) and passes
no unresolved Critical/High security finding; all Medium triaged with a decision
no High-severity correctness/UX backlog item open
docs current (PROJECT_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md, DEV_NOTES.md, README.md, OpenAPI)
every High-importance in-scope feature gap built (auto) or queued with a spec
live-server smoke tests (#13/#17/#18/#22) remain owner-run (hands-off) and are not part of the loop's terminal gate

plan.exit: safety net exists; no High correctness/test gap
Phase-0 done; no unresolved Critical/High finding; all Medium triaged; rounds dry
every High in-scope auto-buildable gap built; Bucket-3 queued with specs
complete review pass: overall PASS @ last_commit
